LESSON: TIME

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Time

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Time. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Time means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Time.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Time
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

REVISION QUIZ: TIME

1. Which statement is true about Time?
   A. Use Time to solve everyday problems
   B. We should ignore Time at home and school.
   C. Time is only for teachers, not learners.
   D. There is no need to practise Time.

2. Which statement is true about Time?
   A. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
   B. We should ignore Time at home and school.
   C. Time is only for teachers, not learners.
   D. There is no need to practise Time.

3. Which statement is true about Time?
   A. Time is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.
   B. We should ignore Time at home and school.
   C. Time is only for teachers, not learners.
   D. There is no need to practise Time.

4. Which statement is true about Time?
   A. At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.
